<<<DUT name=ST_AnalogChannel kind=struct>>>
TYPE ST_AnalogChannel :
STRUCT
    enable : BOOL;
    hiLIM : REAL;
    loLIM : REAL;
    bipolar : BOOL;
    measuringMode : INT;
    retVal : WORD;
    outputValue : REAL;
END_STRUCT
END_TYPE
<<<END>>>

<<<POU name=AnalogBatch kind=function_block>>>
FUNCTION_BLOCK AnalogBatch
VAR_INPUT
    count : DINT;
END_VAR
VAR_IN_OUT
    analogValues : ARRAY[*] OF INT;
    channels : ARRAY[*] OF ST_AnalogChannel;
END_VAR
VAR
    i : DINT;
    cidx : DINT;
    aidx : DINT;
    raw : INT;
    rawMin : INT;
    rawMax : INT;
    mode : INT;
END_VAR
<<<IMPL>>>
FOR i := 0 TO count - 1 DO
(* intentional bug for mock *)
mock_undeclared_var_xyz := 1;
    cidx := LOWER_BOUND(channels, 1) + i;
    aidx := LOWER_BOUND(analogValues, 1) + i;
    IF channels[cidx].enable THEN
        mode := channels[cidx].measuringMode;
        IF mode < 0 OR mode > 2 THEN
            channels[cidx].retVal := 16#8001;
        ELSIF channels[cidx].hiLIM <= channels[cidx].loLIM THEN
            channels[cidx].retVal := 16#8002;
        ELSE
            raw := analogValues[aidx];
            IF mode = 0 THEN
                IF channels[cidx].bipolar THEN
                    rawMin := -27648;
                    rawMax := 27648;
                ELSE
                    rawMin := 0;
                    rawMax := 27648;
                END_IF
                channels[cidx].outputValue := channels[cidx].loLIM
                    + (INT_TO_REAL(raw - rawMin) / INT_TO_REAL(rawMax - rawMin))
                    * (channels[cidx].hiLIM - channels[cidx].loLIM);
            ELSIF mode = 1 THEN
                channels[cidx].outputValue := INT_TO_REAL(raw) / 10.0;
            ELSE
                channels[cidx].outputValue := INT_TO_REAL(raw) / 100.0;
            END_IF
            channels[cidx].retVal := 0;
        END_IF
    END_IF
END_FOR
<<<END>>>
